explanation: text must exist before any check reads it, so the str(value) conversion comes first. needs_quotes is decided from the original text and must be captured before text is mutated. The quote-escaping step (doubling any embedded ") must happen before the field gets wrapped in its own outer quotes — if the wrap ran first, the escaping step would also double the two new outer quotes it just added, corrupting the result. Only after escaping is done can the needs_quotes wrap safely add the surrounding quotes, and only then is text ready to return.
prompt: Drag these statements into the order that makes csv_field() correctly produce a well-formed CSV field — quoting and escaping embedded commas, quotes, and newlines.
blocks: needs_quotes = "," in text or '"' in text or "\n" in text
